S5.1.4 gives the complex-case central coefficient (|S∩T|-1)/2 with the side injection cancelling intersections zero and two, matching lines 756-758.

The plan uses an orthonormal basis of each residual (S5.5, S5.5.1) but never argues its existence: nondegeneracy, the nonalternating property and the absorption of alternating planes are not stated.
S5.4.6 states L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, quoting line 1107.

S5.4.6 gives both ratios below 1/2 and S5.4.7.3 derives the deficit N-2L_b>0 from L_b<N/2 with s_b<W_b m (S5.5.3 gives the complex deficit).

S5.7 asserts the factorization A=E_1ΠE_2 with exactly a ones by quoting the lemma statement (line 1371), but gives no elimination proof (topmost-row rightmost pivot, lower-triangular clearing, repetition on active indices).

S5.8 only asserts that a fixed odd prime q exists; choosing it to avoid every denominator of a finite table of factors so the identities specialize to Z/q^b with invertible triangular factors is not stated.
S5.8.1 states the O(V) cost of a lower triangular transformation by updating coordinates in descending physical order using earlier coordinates that still hold their original values.
S5.8.3 gives D_j<-D_j+H_i, interchange, D_j<-H_i-D_j with one interchange per one of Π, and S5.8.4 gives a=rank(A) interchanges in all.
The plan defines E=64(W+m+1)^3, B=s+E, ν=min{j≥1: m^j≥B}, C_1=max{20,ν+3}, C_0=128mB^2 and Δ=⌈C_0d^{C_1}⌉, with C_1=20 in S8.1.1; the value ν=11 is not stated.
S5.11.7.1 states A(e)≤sA(e/m)+E at an internal node and A(e)≤8e at a leaf, with E bounding the gates and corrections of one invocation, and S5.11.7.2 explains the factor s.

S5.11.7.7 gives values at depth ℓ in 2^{-(p+ℓ)}Z[i] of modulus ≤2^ℓ and the p+Δ fractional, Δ+3 integer bits, and S5.11.7.8 gives εC_1<1 implying Δ=o(p).

summary: P03 covers the bank-exchange network (B1-B4), the complex phase interface (P1-P4), the rank saving (R1-R4) and the simultaneous-layer guard-width analysis (S1-S5) in full, with P3 credited through the layer steps and P4 slightly compressed. It misses the residual table (L1), the side edge 2->5 residual of dimension h-2 (L2), the nonalternating/orthonormal-basis argument (L4), the elimination proof of the triangular factorization (M1) and the choice of the prime avoiding denominators (M2). 21 of 26 present, none wrong.
